content:
Hey everyone!! sharing something I've been building.
Leafy lets you and your team annotate any webpage. You click an element (or highlight text), leave a comment, @ mention teammates, and they get notified.
Comments are anchored to specific parts of the page and sync across devices.
Use cases I've seen people use it for:
→ SEO Teams (most of my users)
→ Researchers annotating sources together (second highest share of my userbase)
→ Product teams reviewing features on their products
→ Designers leaving feedback on live prototypes
→ QA marking bugs on staging environments
→ Sales teams using it on salesforce
→ Students using it for marking interesting things on any page, to study
You can organise teams into "Gardens" (I know, quirky naming). Free tier supports up to 3 gardens with 5 members each.
I'd love any feedback! especially on what feels broken or missing.
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/leafy-annotate-the-web-to/doohbmfpjanoimbigjbjocanpenbfkkh
Product page: https://get-leafy.com/
